text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka managed to achieve stellar results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through
those truly precious "first three years"—

"That day, the two of us
were watching the footage of her debut race."

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text: "What kind of drama will unfold from here on out—!?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, that brings back memories.

Even back then, Silence Suzuka stood head and shoulders
above the rest, clearly displaying her exceptional talent.
Over the course of these three years, her talent has come to be hailed as "legendary."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"A lot... happened.
Truly, a whole lot."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not... really confident about that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like
I haven't changed much from three years ago.

Seeing how brilliantly she performs in races,
there's no way I could ever think she hasn't grown.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've always loved running...
I guess you could say it's all I've ever thought about.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I guess I never really thought much about anything other than 'wanting to take the lead'...?
"—Certainly, there were twists and turns along the way, but her core remains unchanged."

"I want to see beautiful scenery."
That single obsession is what drives her to run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I... as long as I run true to myself, that is enough.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Looking at it this way, my way of thinking might have matured a little—
The debut race she had been gazing blankly at seemed to have come to an end.
A brief glimpse shows Silence Suzuka from that day, smiling with quiet satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —I was truly happy on this day.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how I'll be able
to run from here on out. It makes me so excited.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, this was the beginning, wasn't it?

Silence Suzuka murmured, turning toward me
with a renewed, formal expression.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
I'll continue to be in your care,
Trainer-san.
